title: Gobbo'z and Cobbo'z
description: A modpack focused on Create and Cobblemon
body:
A modpack built around Create and Cobblemon, mixing automation and adventure into one smooth experience. Build factories, trains, and contraptions with Create and some its many addons such as Create Steam and Rails, Create Connected, Create Enchantment Industry, and many more. Or, explore the world to battle and collect Cobblemon. Battle trainer's and gyms, and create your ultimate team. Capture even more Cobblemon thanks to AllTheMons with over 150 more Cobblemon. Go beyond your Cobblemon's limtis with Mega Showdown using mega evolutions, z-moves, teralization, and dynamax.

Enjoy massive views with Distant Horizons, easy organization with Sophisticated Backpacks and Sophisticated Storage, and plenty of decoration mods for building. Performance mods like Sodium, Entity Culling, ImmediatelyFast, and FerriteCore keep things running smoothly, with optional shader support via Iris for enhanced visuals.
